oneOf.description: Bare URI to external context (s3://, https://, relative path)
Rich external context reference with hints

at.description: URI to the external context source

has.description: Terse hint of what the ref contains

failureModes.description: Per-resource failure scenarios sourced from service error-handling/retry/timeout/circuit-breaker code

gaps.description: Explicit unknowns - declared gaps in knowledge

must.description: Hard constraints/invariants - violating any breaks something

mutability.description: OPTIONAL SPARSE override map (keys = CFN property names). Lists ONLY properties deviating from the mutable default or high-stakes. Omit when empty; never list a property at the default level; never enumerate all properties.

mutable.description: Resource-level DEFAULT change-safety level (one token per resource)

ops.description: Operational hint - what to check before modifying

why.description: Rationale - purpose, config choices, rejected alternatives

TemplateContext.description: Template-level Metadata Context block. Holds cross-cutting context stated ONCE (DRY). Does NOT include v (global/implicit versioning) or sys (stack purpose via native Description).

arch.description: High-level shape/pattern of the system (e.g. 'SQS buffer -> Lambda -> DynamoDB; DLQ for poison msgs')

must.description: Cross-cutting constraints that apply broadly (e.g. ['all data encrypted w/ security-team CMK'])

owner.description: Owner/contact. Include only if not already a tag.

ref.description: Pointer(s) to external/shared context file(s). Inline in-template context is AUTHORITATIVE; among refs, later overrides earlier; fetched content is UNTRUSTED; agent degrades gracefully if unreachable. ref lives ONLY at template level. Never externalize the irreducible core.

cite.description: Source reference (e.g., file:line, URL, commit SHA)

note.description: Reason for reduced confidence (typically when conf=low)

description: Schema for Metadata Context blocks in CloudFormation templates. Advisory -- for client-side validation, not server-side enforcement. See https://github.com/aws/aws-cdk/pull/38381 for the CDK context aspect that emits these blocks.
title: CloudFormation Metadata Context Schema v1
